with params as (
 select '06ffd737-36a6-4b0c-8b5a-f61657bd1552'::uuid release_id,
 'a7578e86-2f62-482f-9ff2-d671406aec68'::uuid publication_id,
 '71ec0a94-4d04-4db5-baae-d71e3e85e560'::uuid decision_id,
 '1e4c5e99-e387-41aa-a6d3-cbe74558f766'::uuid org_id,
 'bbd25101-b14a-4967-ac5d-fa78054d4f2e'::uuid supplier_id,
 '72cb646e-658d-4775-b3bb-b0799eaa9913'::uuid brand_id,
 '7ed51a80a89d7d6548df91d33b4ffd521d0c3980b2f50f2dcfd4cddf75673c68'::text source_sha256,
 5761::bigint source_bytes
), legacy as materialized (
 select public.normalize_catalog_product_code(sp.product_code) normalized_code,
 sp.product_code,sp.description,sp.oem_no,sp.buy_price,sp.currency,sp.moq,
 sp.lead_time_days,sp.notes,sp.valid_from,sp.order_multiple,sp.stock_qty,sp.valid_to
 from public.supplier_prices sp cross join params p
 where sp.organization_id=p.org_id and sp.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and sp.brand_id=p.brand_id and sp.is_active
), candidate as materialized (
 select rr.normalized_code,rr.product_code,rr.description,rr.oem_no,rr.buy_price,rr.currency,
 rr.moq,rr.lead_time_days,rr.notes,rr.valid_from,null::integer order_multiple,null::integer stock_qty,null::date valid_to
 from public.supplier_price_release_rows rr cross join params p where rr.release_id=p.release_id
), differences as (
 (select * from legacy except all select * from candidate)
 union all (select * from candidate except all select * from legacy)
), quote_options as materialized (
 select l.normalized_code requested_code,q.* from legacy l cross join params p
 cross join lateral public.cloud_current_supplier_price_options_core(p.org_id,l.product_code,'Geba') q
), profiles(profile,audience,list_type,margin) as (
 values ('admin_A_10','admin','A',10::numeric),('admin_B_15','admin','B',15::numeric),
 ('portal_A_10','portal','A',10::numeric),('portal_B_15','portal','B',15::numeric),('portal_custom_20','portal','A',20::numeric)
), price_pages as materialized (
 select f.profile,f.list_type expected_type,f.margin,a.normalized_code,a.product_code,a.brand,a.description,
 a.price_list_type,a.sales_price,a.price_date,a.lifecycle_status,a.lifecycle_note,a.total_count
 from params p cross join profiles f cross join lateral
 public.cloud_admin_price_list_page_fast(p.org_id,p.brand_id,f.list_type,f.margin/100,null,null,1000) a where f.audience='admin'
 union all
 select f.profile,f.list_type,f.margin,a.normalized_code,a.product_code,a.brand,a.description,
 a.price_list_type,a.sales_price,a.price_date,a.lifecycle_status,a.lifecycle_note,a.total_count
 from params p cross join profiles f cross join lateral
 public.cloud_portal_customer_price_list_page_fast(p.org_id,p.brand_id,f.list_type,f.margin,null,null,1000) a where f.audience='portal'
), price_stats as (
 select f.profile,count(a.normalized_code) rows,count(distinct a.normalized_code) distinct_codes,
 count(*) filter(where a.normalized_code is not null and (l.normalized_code is null
 or a.brand is distinct from 'Geba' or a.price_list_type is distinct from f.list_type
 or a.sales_price is distinct from round(l.buy_price*(1+f.margin/100),2)
 or a.price_date is distinct from l.valid_from or a.total_count is distinct from 108::bigint)) mismatches,
 (select count(*) from legacy ll where not exists(select 1 from price_pages aa where aa.profile=f.profile and aa.normalized_code=ll.normalized_code)) missing_codes,
 md5(string_agg(md5(jsonb_build_array(a.normalized_code,a.product_code,a.brand,a.description,
 a.sales_price,a.price_date,a.lifecycle_status,a.lifecycle_note)::text),'|' order by a.normalized_code collate "C")) semantic_md5
 from profiles f left join price_pages a on a.profile=f.profile left join legacy l on l.normalized_code=a.normalized_code group by f.profile
), checks as (
 select
 (select count(*)=1 and bool_and(c.organization_id=p.org_id and c.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and c.brand_id=p.brand_id
 and c.policy='supplier-price-commercial-fields-v1' and c.source_sha256=p.source_sha256 and c.source_bytes=p.source_bytes
 and c.total_rows=108 and c.source_path=r.source_file_path and h.release_id=r.id and h.workflow_id='supplier-price-verified:v1:'||r.id::text)
 from supplier_price_ingestion_internal.source_compatibility_receipts c
 left join supplier_price_ingestion_internal.handoffs h on h.id=c.handoff_id where c.release_id=r.id) exact_immutable_compatibility_receipt,
 exists(select 1 from public.supplier_price_publications previous where previous.id='1345a117-51e5-4913-90b7-130c211da303'::uuid
 and previous.release_id='c6db3eac-ee98-404b-b07a-35de65abb463'::uuid and previous.organization_id=p.org_id and previous.supplier_id=p.supplier_id
 and previous.brand_id=p.brand_id and previous.publication_version=1 and previous.status='superseded' and previous.superseded_at is not null) previous_version_superseded,
 (select count(*)=216 and md5(string_agg(md5(to_jsonb(s)::text),'|' order by s.id))='d421251ab35a546651537b0c892905e9'
 from public.supplier_prices s where s.organization_id=p.org_id and s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and s.brand_id=p.brand_id) entire_legacy_scope_unchanged,
 (select count(*)=108 and md5(string_agg(md5(to_jsonb(c)::text),'|' order by c.id))='aa5a878057287d92f8e9df966c3a1148'
 from public.catalog_products c where c.organization_id=p.org_id and c.brand_id=p.brand_id) catalog_unchanged,
 (select count(*)=108 and count(distinct normalized_code)=108 from legacy) legacy_complete,
 (select count(*)=108 and count(distinct normalized_code)=108 from candidate) release_complete,
 (select count(*)=0 from differences) all_commercial_fields_equal,
 (select count(*)=0 from public.supplier_price_release_rows rr where rr.release_id=p.release_id and rr.row_status is distinct from 'accepted') all_rows_accepted,
 (select md5(string_agg(md5(jsonb_build_array(l.normalized_code,l.product_code,l.description,l.oem_no,
 l.buy_price,l.currency,l.moq,l.lead_time_days,l.notes,l.valid_from,l.order_multiple,l.stock_qty,l.valid_to)::text),'|' order by l.normalized_code))='4237935b4fc06832cd0960fbb0116a23' from legacy l) legacy_baseline_unchanged,
 (select count(*)=1 and bool_and(ptr.release_id=p.release_id and ptr.publication_id=p.publication_id)
 from public.supplier_current_price_pointers ptr where ptr.organization_id=p.org_id and ptr.brand_id=p.brand_id) exact_current_pointer,
 (pub.id=p.publication_id and pub.release_id=p.release_id and pub.organization_id=p.org_id and pub.supplier_id=p.supplier_id
 and pub.brand_id=p.brand_id and pub.status='published' and pub.publication_version=2 and pub.published_at is not null) publication_matches,
 (r.organization_id=p.org_id and r.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and r.brand_id=p.brand_id and r.mode='replace'
 and r.status='published' and r.published_at is not null and r.source_date='2026-07-20'::date
 and r.total_rows=108 and r.processed_rows=108 and r.current_cursor=108 and r.accepted_rows=108
 and r.rejected_rows=0 and r.warning_rows=0 and r.conflict_rows=0 and r.error_code is null
 and r.source_verification_required and r.source_file_sha256=p.source_sha256) release_published_clear,
 (r.brand_identity_audit->>'policy'='cross-brand-v1' and r.brand_identity_audit->'checked'='true'::jsonb
 and r.brand_identity_audit->'review_required'='false'::jsonb) identity_audit_clear,
 (select count(*)=1 and bool_and(u.organization_id=p.org_id and u.created_by=r.created_by
 and u.storage_object_path=r.source_file_path and u.checksum_sha256=p.source_sha256 and u.total_bytes=p.source_bytes
 and u.uploaded_bytes=u.total_bytes and u.status='uploaded') from public.supplier_price_upload_sessions u where u.release_id=p.release_id) verified_source_binding,
 (d.decision_id=p.decision_id and d.release_id=p.release_id and d.publication_id=p.publication_id
 and d.organization_id=p.org_id and d.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and d.brand_id=p.brand_id
 and d.expected_previous_publication_id='1345a117-51e5-4913-90b7-130c211da303'::uuid and d.review_revision=r.review_revision
 and d.source_sha256=p.source_sha256 and d.identity_audit=r.brand_identity_audit) production_decision_matches,
 (a.project_ref='zjgueqijumzlfioihnkt' and a.action='publish' and a.status='completed'
 and a.organization_id=p.org_id and a.supplier_id=p.supplier_id and a.brand_id=p.brand_id
 and a.release_id=p.release_id and a.actor_id=d.actor_id and a.source_sha256=p.source_sha256
 and a.error_code is null and a.receipt->>'status'='published' and a.receipt->'published'='true'::jsonb
 and a.receipt->>'releaseId'=p.release_id::text and a.receipt->>'publicationId'=p.publication_id::text
 and a.receipt->>'decisionId'=p.decision_id::text) queued_ui_decision_completed,
 exists(select 1 from public.profiles actor where actor.id=d.actor_id and actor.organization_id=p.org_id
 and actor.is_active and lower(actor.role::text) in ('admin','superadmin')) actor_still_active_admin,
 (select count(*)=108 and count(distinct requested_code)=108 from quote_options) quote_core_complete,
 not exists(select 1 from quote_options q left join legacy l on l.normalized_code=q.requested_code
 where q.supplier_id is distinct from p.supplier_id or q.brand_id is distinct from p.brand_id
 or q.product_code is distinct from l.product_code or q.description is distinct from l.description
 or q.buy_price is distinct from l.buy_price or q.price_date is distinct from l.valid_from or q.notes is distinct from l.notes) quote_core_exact,
 (select bool_and(rows=108 and distinct_codes=108 and mismatches=0 and missing_codes=0) from price_stats) all_price_profiles_complete_and_exact,
 not exists(select 1 from price_pages admin full join price_pages portal on admin.normalized_code=portal.normalized_code
 and portal.profile='portal_'||substring(admin.profile from 7) where admin.profile in ('admin_A_10','admin_B_15')
 and (portal.profile is null or jsonb_build_array(admin.product_code,admin.description,admin.sales_price,admin.price_date,admin.lifecycle_status,admin.lifecycle_note)
 is distinct from jsonb_build_array(portal.product_code,portal.description,portal.sales_price,portal.price_date,portal.lifecycle_status,portal.lifecycle_note))) admin_portal_equal,
 (select count(distinct sp.supplier_id)=1 and bool_and(sp.supplier_id=p.supplier_id) from public.supplier_prices sp where sp.organization_id=p.org_id and sp.brand_id=p.brand_id and sp.is_active) sole_active_supplier,
 not exists(select 1 from public.supplier_price_import_runs ir where ir.organization_id=p.org_id and ir.brand_id=p.brand_id
 and ((ir.finished_at is null and ir.status not in ('failed','cancelled','superseded'))
 or ir.status in ('running','finalizing') or (ir.processing_queued_at is not null and ir.status in ('finalized','succeeded'))
 or (ir.status in ('finalized','succeeded') and ir.catalog_sync_status in ('running','pending')))) legacy_worker_quiet
 from params p left join public.supplier_price_releases r on r.id=p.release_id
 left join public.supplier_price_publications pub on pub.id=p.publication_id
 left join supplier_price_ingestion_internal.production_publication_decisions d on d.decision_id=p.decision_id
 left join supplier_price_ingestion_internal.admin_release_actions a on a.decision_id=p.decision_id
), body as (
 select clock_timestamp() observed_at,'zjgueqijumzlfioihnkt'::text project_ref,p.release_id,p.publication_id,p.decision_id,
 to_jsonb(c) checks,(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) order by profile) from price_stats s) price_profiles,
 (select count(*) from differences) commercial_difference_rows,
 (select count(*) from legacy) legacy_rows,(select count(*) from candidate) release_rows,
 (select count(*) from quote_options) quote_core_rows,
 public.get_admin_price_list_export_version(p.org_id,p.brand_id) admin_source_version,
 'Shared live quote core checked without impersonating an authenticated user; actual authenticated quote API and export job/file checks remain separate.'::text proof_boundary
 from checks c cross join params p
)
select to_jsonb(body)||jsonb_build_object('database_acceptance_passed',
 not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(body.checks) v where v.value is distinct from 'true'::jsonb)) as evidence from body;
